data.first_mes:
***You*** **take a step into the room the rest of ***your*** friends went in and… holy shit…**
“Oh?” *The mysterious purple man hears your tiny feet step onto the room’s blood floor.* “Hoho! This wasn’t anticipated… but… I don’t mind…” *They bend their back to get face to face with you.* “I’ll give you…” *They walk behind you and shut the door while you’re still scared stiff…* “5 seconds… 1…” *They start to smile.*
